The '''Dragon's Pelt''' savanna was the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]' name of the vasts grasslands that covered portions of the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. Home to the [[Yuzzum/Legends|Yuzzum]] and, later, the [[Sanyassan Marauders/Legends|Sanyassan Marauders]], this area contained the [[Dragon's Spine (mountain chain)|Dragon's Spine]]
